summary: Langfuse now groups an engagement's traces into a session per room and types the plumbing spans, so a trace can be filtered down to the model work.
details: Every span carries session.id and gen_ai.conversation.id from its room; children inherit from their parent.
store.* reads are typed retriever, engagement.admission guardrail, and the other stage and event-loop spans chain.
docs/observability.md now describes the collector as it is: tail sampling per trace for Langfuse, chat spans only dropped for Jaeger.
limitations: The session is the room, so a busy group room is one long session.
